If a customer replaces the rear tires with non-standard tiires, or complains of speedometer inaccuracy, the speedometer may need to be recalibrated.
Follow the procedure below to recalibrate.
1. Measure the rear tire's rolling radius (the Y dimension below)
2. Multiply this value by 2 to get the Rolling Diameter. This value will be less than X above.

Adjust the parameters below only if the customer requires some customization with the sunction fan ramp-up time.
For example, if the customer wants the suction fan to come up to speed faster, adjust these values to a faster time (a smaller value).
1. Ensure Fuel Tank is as full as possible. 2. Adjust value below "Up" in 100mV increments until the tank shows Full.

Do not adjust this parameter unless the Fuel Level Gauge is not showing FULL when the tank is actually full. If the Fuel Gauge does not show full when the tank is actually full, follow the procedure below.

Note: If this value is set too high the fuel gauge will show full for an extended amount of time until the tank gets low enough. This value should be set such that the system barely recognizes the tank is full.
IMPORTANT: For best results, perform this calibration when the engine has NOT been run for at least 30 minutes and is at ambient temperature. The engine should NOT be running during this procedure

1. Use a laser thermometer to measure the temeprature of the bottom tank of the hydraulic oil cooler. Write down this temperature for reference.
2. Observe the System Oil Temperature below.
3. If the temperature in Step 2 is the same as the temperature recoreded in Step 1, there is no calibration requirement.
4. If the temperature is Step 2 differs from the recorded temperature in Step 1, adjust the Oil Temperature Calibration Point Up or Down in increments of 10 until the Step 1 and Step 2 values match.
Front Sweeps and Power Assist Cart System are optional features that must be activated below.

As standard equipment, the Stick Box Buttons in the cab are momentary-on switches. This is to operate the stick box actuator correctly on a cart with a stick remover.
If the customer does not have a cart with a stick remover, the "Close" stick box button in the cab will act as a toggle on\off switch (able to be utilized by a different function if required).
